# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# Drawpile Mobile (fork): translations for the mobile interface plus fixes for
# upstream strings that are untranslated in Russian and Ukrainian. The .ts
# files are generated by generate.py. They get bundled after upstream's
# catalogs, so their entries take precedence.
include(DrawpileTranslations)

set(mobileui_ts_files mobileui_ru_RU.ts mobileui_uk_UA.ts)
_add_translation(mobileui_qm_files ${mobileui_ts_files})

add_custom_target(drawpile_mobileui_i18n DEPENDS ${mobileui_qm_files})
set_target_properties(drawpile_mobileui_i18n PROPERTIES
	DP_TRANSLATION_QM_FILES "${mobileui_qm_files}"
)
add_dependencies(drawpile drawpile_mobileui_i18n)
